title: Generating Data to Mitigate Spurious Correlations in Natural Language Inference Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on the SNLI-hard and MNLI-hard challenge subsets, which filter out test instances that can be correctly guessed by a model that only has access to the hypothesis text.

Evaluating model robustness on the HANS dataset, which contains adversarial examples designed to test whether models rely on fallible syntactic heuristics like lexical overlap, subsequence, and constituent features.

Evaluating models on a suite of adversarial test sets for NLI (from Liu et al., 2020b) that target distinct biases such as partial-input heuristics, surface patterns, lexically misleading instances, and stress tests involving word-overlap, negation, and length mismatch.
